decisions.reason: 한 단어 is one word from his 입; SOL pluralizes to words and changes mouth to lips.
아니더라도 is concessive even-if-not, not agnostic whether-or-not.
꾸벅꾸벅 is repeated bowing; Sword Saint, Mae Jonghak matches 검성 매종학.
Th-this is the natural English stammer for 이, 이럴.
Stammered in denial tightens 더듬거리며 현실을 부정하던 without adding meaning.
Government connections is cleaner; figures fits 권력자 better than men for Hong Jin.
Lifeline naturalizes 구원의 손길 and drops unsupported possibly.
SOL drops 잠시, for a moment.
영 문외한 is next to nothing, not merely no expert; 던데요 is retrospective.
야 is a flustered stammer; SOL smooths it out.
SOL drops 나지막이, quietly.
다른 손님 is other guests; some is extra.
콧소리 is nasality; lilt adds an unsupported musical quality.
심기가 불편 is a superior’s displeasure; uncomfortable is calqued and foul overstates.
decisions.replacement: “Wouldn’t the presence of uninvited guests put His Highness in a bad mood?”

decisions.reason: 거기에 더해 is on top of that, not a step up to Worse.
Must I matches 어머; tell His Highness you were coming is cleaner speech.
Glossary is palace attendant and 본래 is originally; SOL’s had been makes the role past.
decisions.replacement: Hong Jin was originally a palace attendant. He had remained at Prince Shangshan’s side since the prince was an infant, and thanks to that, he had risen to the post of Deputy Military Commissioner, becoming the power behind the Shanxi Provincial Office and the second-ranking figure in the military.

decisions.reason: This line is 고작 미리 말을 못 했다, with no 전하; merely matches 고작.
저, 저는 is I, I; SOL adds I’m afraid.
After a dismissal, 눈치가 없는 is failing to take a hint.
Silence line is kept in the merged H022 paragraph.
폭언 is verbal abuse, not a mere insult; merge keeps 사방이 고요해졌다.
decisions.replacement: The sudden verbal abuse plunged the hall into silence. Gong Ilhyuk and the other two members of the Three Hands of Zhongnan clenched their trembling fists.

decisions.reason: You go too far is spoken English for 말씀이 과하시군요.
느꼈다면 is how it felt; 일부러 is on purpose.
이러시는 is acting like this, not specifically treating me.
Hardly/much less is sharper Hong Jin speech for 기대하고 실망할 사이.
그런…… is That…, and 종남파 is the glossary name; SOL drops both.
decisions.replacement: “That… have you forgotten your agreement with our Zhongnan Sect?”

decisions.reason: Oh, the one about… is tighter and still 그거.
피식 is a short laugh, not merely quiet.
상응하는 is commensurate; 질책 is not harsh; For now is extra.
Venture matches this 일 better than switching to deal.
Threat explanation is kept in the merged H033 sentence.
Adding grudges to gratitude matches 덧붙인; veiled matches 은근한.
Glossary palace attendant and 어린 시절부터; 속뜻 is hidden meaning, which SOL drops.
decisions.replacement: Hong Jin had served as a palace attendant since childhood and witnessed all manner of political intrigue. There was no chance he had missed the hidden meaning behind Gong Ilhyuk’s words.

decisions.reason: 쯧쯧 is tsk, not Hmph or Honestly; 이래서 무림인들이란 does not say hopeless or a pain.
decisions.replacement: *Tsk. This is why martial artists are the way they are.*

decisions.reason: 언행 하나하나 names no Gong Ilhyuk; dropping the name is faithful.
과묵 is taciturn; 뚝심 있는 is stubborn grit, not noble steadfast.
decisions.replacement: Compared to a half-polished man like Gong Ilhyuk, Li Feng—taciturn, stubborn, and every inch a martial artist—was a far more troublesome opponent.

decisions.reason: SOL drops 지금, right now.
Both omit 설설 기어도 모자랄 텐데; SOL also turns the goal into wanting something from him.
decisions.replacement: If he had a goal he wanted to achieve, even crawling on the ground would hardly have been enough. And yet he had added a threat on top of everything else.

decisions.reason: 마음을 굳혔다 is settling the decision, stronger than helped make up his mind.
Tighter speech; keep working with you matches 같이 일 못 해요.
오해의 소지가 있었다면 is impersonal; SOL adds I left.
몰랐던 척 is feigning ignorance, not denying intent; 툭 is casually.
개도 is not even a passing dog.
이, 이…… is a doubled stammer, not a single You.
SOL drops 나중에; 밥상 is the table, not the entire meal.
decisions.replacement: “Hey, Seniors of the Zhongnan Sect. I don’t know what kind of incredible business you’re running, but couldn’t you discuss it somewhere else later? I’m already miserable enough about the table being overturned.”

decisions.reason: 보며 is looking; stared intensifies without support.
새로 food can be fresh; 그렇죠 is a confirmation tag, not All right.
decisions.replacement: “Don’t worry. Once these gentlemen leave, I’ll have fresh food brought in. Isn’t that right?”

decisions.reason: Now… shoving them out is direct English for 등까지 떠미는 상황.
형편없다 is terrible, present; stand to gain and lose is the natural 잃고 얻을지.
decisions.replacement: “Deputy Military Commissioner, I admit my judgment is terrible. But please think carefully about what you stand to gain and lose from today’s events.”

decisions.reason: Reached this decision fits a thoroughly weighed 내린 결정.
그게 무슨…… trails off; both drop the ellipsis, and 그게 is that.
decisions.replacement: “What does that mean…?”

decisions.reason: 계속 진행 is continue, not merely proceed.
That’s all the more reason is more spoken for 더욱더.
처절하게까지 느껴지는 is actually desperate; almost weakens it.
제가 알기로는 is as far as I know; the em-dash contrast is cleaner.
House style uses a single ellipsis character.
지난 수백 년간 is the past several hundred years, not generic centuries.
가벼운 질책 is a light reprimand; 다른 문파도 아니고 is instead of some other sect.
당연히 이럴 수 있죠 is of course I can, not quite easily.
Surpassed them avoids repeating Huashan after it was just named.
보기 좋아요 is good to see, not admirable; 말이 keeps the phrase.
Without missing a beat is idiomatic 막힘없이.
그건 is That is, trailing off; house ellipsis, not SOL’s clipped That.
decisions.replacement: “…That is…”

decisions.reason: 소협 is Young Hero; does it have parallels the Sword Saint question.
Could easily answer and could answer easily are indistinguishable.
종종 is occasionally, closer than sometimes.
듣도 보도 못했다 and 특히 merge cleanly without losing the kneel-in-one-exchange beat.
Flush-and-kneel detail is kept in the merged H068 paragraph.
No fewer Peak masters is natural English for 숫자는 … 밀리지 않습니다.
Quoted 어떤 is the point of the line; 품었느냐 is possesses.
decisions.replacement: “I’ve heard that the strength of a Murim sect doesn’t depend on how many masters it has, but on *what kind* of masters it possesses.”

decisions.reason: Struck the heart of the matter naturalizes 정곡을 찌르다 better than bull’s-eye.
뺏기는 is having the place taken, not handed over.
Keeps 서투르고 as clumsy instead of collapsing it into inexperienced.
누군가 is someone; else is unsupported.
Watched everything in silence is clean 묵묵히 지켜보고.
맞는 말입니다 endorses the statement, not He is correct.
묵직한 목소리 is a heavy voice; But marks the turn after Gong’s relief.
처음이란 게 is a first time, answering inexperience; begin somewhere is a different proverb.
깔깔 웃었다 is burst out laughing.
진짜 많이 늘었다 is truly come a long way.
정반대 is the exact opposite; 같은 내용 stays almost exactly the same.
화기애애한 is warm and friendly, not perfect harmony.
Act as and serve as are indistinguishable for 다리를 놔 주다.
장문인께서도 is the Sect Leader as well; SOL drops 도.
Keeps 도; 귀한 손님 is an honored guest, not calqued precious.
decisions.replacement: “Ah, and you should also tell him that we have an honored guest here.”

decisions.reason: 시작이 좋네요 is It’s a good start; we’re off adds agency.
제 생각도 그렇습니다 is I think so too, not a bare I agree.
The participial opener is cleaner without changing 완전히 배제된.
Too-far-to-turn-back is kept in the merged H091 sentence.
이미 is already; a gaze filled with fury and betrayal matches 섞인 눈빛.
Glossary Great Zhongnan Sect; 무시하다 as look down on sets up the retort.
SOL drops 불쑥 끼어든; 피식 is a short laugh.
decisions.replacement: The voice belonged to Jin Taekyung, who had suddenly cut into the conversation. He gave a short laugh and continued.

decisions.reason: Matches H092’s 무시; 꼬박꼬박 is faithfully kept up.
끼어들 is butting in, not interfering; SOL also drops 따위.
decisions.replacement: “What kind of bullshit are you spouting? A family without even a proper pedigree like the Jin Family of Taiyuan has no place butting in!”

decisions.reason: Comma keeps the poke-and-tell as one spoken beat.
고 links the fear and the request in one breath.
Your Benefactor in name parallels the first question without changing 말만 은인.
대로 is say what I tell you; exactly is extra.
끝나자 is finished; 뭐라 is something, which SOL drops.
decisions.replacement: After Taekyung finished whispering something to him, Cheongpung hesitantly opened his mouth.

decisions.reason: G-get… get… is the cleaner stammer for 꺼, 꺼…….
응원에 힘을 얻은 is buoyed by encouragement, not merely encouraged.
Keeps 정확히 and 단어; SOL flattens both.
이런 쳐 죽일…… trails off; BASE adds bastards not in this line.
눈을 부릅떴다 is eyes wide open; SOL drops the physical beat.
그들이 누구인가 is a rhetorical beat SOL deletes.
본산 is headquarters, not main branch; 치욕 is humiliation, not insult.
decisions.replacement: They were disciples of the Zhongnan Sect’s headquarters. They were accustomed to the admiring gazes of others, and this was a humiliation they could never wash away.

decisions.reason: Turn-away is kept in the merged H109 sentence.
울분을 참으며 돌아섰다 must stay; 갚아 주기 is repay, not avenge.
decisions.replacement: Swallowing his outrage, he turned away. Neither the opponent nor the place was suitable for repaying this humiliation.

decisions.reason: 오늘 일은 … 갚는다 as a revenge vow is make them pay; repay this sounds like settling a debt.
으스러져라 is crushingly hard; BASE invents creaking knuckles and SOL drops the force.
decisions.replacement: Blood dripped from the fist he clenched so hard it seemed it would crush.

decisions.reason: 거친 발걸음 must stay; SOL’s merge drops the footsteps.
등 뒤로 … 목소리가 따라붙었다 is the follow-up sentence after the rough exit.
욕 처음 해 봐요 is specifically a first time swearing.
처음치고는 is for a first attempt; 앞으로 and 쓰기 stay as from now on / use them.
